exposure: presence of microorganisms in amniotic fluid
microbial community structure in amniotic fluid
outcome: infection-related adverse pregnancy outcomes (preterm birth, histological chorioamnionitis, stillbirth)
cohort: The study included two cohorts: 51 women with healthy pregnancies who underwent term and elective cesarean section, and 22 women who experienced infection-related adverse pregnancy outcomes.
finding: No microorganisms were detected in the amniotic fluid of healthy pregnancies from the second trimester to delivery, while Ureaplasma and Lactobacillus in second trimester amniotic fluid were associated with infection-related adverse pregnancy outcomes.
gest_age: 19-21 gestational weeks (second trimester) and at time of delivery (term or preterm)
